author: Firefly
text:
Kruger.... my first venture into SilverusingSD. Got in close to where I now see you did. Before going to workI moved my SL tojust below break even. Cant trade at work.

Would not anyway. But the spike upprobably took me out.

Anyway. If you have been trading Silver for a long time,how would you compare it with tradinga currency pair,i.e. EurUsd or AudUsd?

Does it give betterSD signals?for instance?

Hi Firefly:)

I fully understand problems related to trading and holding trades open while you are away from charts and also why you moved SL, That's why I'm happy that you have chosen higher time frames. I hope that your trade is safe! In this case I felt pretty confident and I even had plan to add to this position somewhere between blue lines above first entry.

My experience with silver is rather small so it's hard for me to catch nuances, but in fact I really don't care if this is silver or gold or anything else. I use this information only for calculating my risk (pip value).

All instruments are moving in accordance with the law of supply and demand and this is the most important.
